def math_in_quote(md: 'Markdown') ->None:
    """Enable block math plugin in quote."""
    def parse_block_math_in_quote(block: "BlockParser", m: Match[str], state: "BlockState") -> int:
        text = m.group("math_text")
        state.append_token({"type": "block_math", "raw": text})
        return m.end() + 1
    
    # Modify the block math pattern to work in quotes
    # Allow 0-3 spaces OR > followed by optional spaces at start of line
    modified_pattern = r'^ *(>?)( {0,3}\$\$[ \t]*\n(?P<math_text>[\s\S]+?)\n\$\$[ \t]*$)'
    md.block.register('block_math', modified_pattern, parse_block_math_in_quote, before='list')
